fonts.heading: Chivo
fonts.pairing_strategy: Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Do not default to 'Bold'. Use font-black for major titles and font-light for elegance.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4.
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift, subtle shadow, darker border.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Paragraphs/Labels: left-aligned. Buttons relative to container.
spacing_and_layout.optical_alignment: Icons in buttons should use 4px padding towards the text.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Lighter hue for active states.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out or transition-transform for scaling.
motion_and_interactions.toasts: Use Sonner. Ensure high contrast and snappy entrance/exit. Success toasts must use the defined 'success' color.

surfaces.header: Solid Background with a hard bottom border (1px border-border). Not glassmorphism, as this is a high-contrast functional dashboard.
surfaces.admin_login_panel: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Exposed skeleton, brutalist edges.
surfaces.webcam_container: Tracing Beam or Reticle corners. 1px border with a soft inner shadow to denote 'active recording' area.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). High contrast. Primary uses solid brand color, Secondary uses outline with transparent background.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn Form components. Labels uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs. Inputs with sharp corners, 1px border. No floating labels.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table. Left-aligned data. Dense padding (py-2 px-4). Distinct hover state on rows (bg-muted).
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use monochromatic or brand-tinted bars/lines to maintain the brutalist feel. Avoid rainbow colors.
components_strategy.toast: Sonner for attendance marking success. Real-time, anchored bottom-right.

image_urls.description: Brutalist university architecture, to be used as a half-screen background image on the Admin Login page, with a monochrome/dark overlay (bg-black/50) to ensure high contrast.
Black and white geometric pattern. Can be used subtly (opacity 5%) in the background of the main dashboard to add texture without reducing readability.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for elegance or 2.5 for bold brutalist weight. Use icons for 'Users', 'Camera', 'Video', 'LogOut', 'Download' (CSV export).

features_spec.admin_login: JWT auth. Split layout (left: form, right: architecture image).
features_spec.user_registration: Form + Live Webcam feed to capture face. Needs 'Capture' button.
features_spec.face_recognition_attendance: Full-screen or large centered webcam view. Real-time bounding boxes drawn via OpenCV (backend) and streamed, or handled purely in backend with a static snapshot feed. Successful match triggers Sonner toast.
features_spec.attendance_dashboard: Tabs: 'Overview', 'Logs', 'Users'. Overview shows Recharts activity. Logs shows date-filtered table. Users shows registered faces.
features_spec.export_csv: Prominent button in the Logs table header.
features_spec.theme_toggle: Icon button in header. Switches dark/light classes on html tag.

accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='capture-face-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Text contrast must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards. Ensure hover/focus states are clearly visible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme strictly: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast). No card shadows, use sharp corners (rounded-none).
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Install required dependencies: react-webcam, recharts, sonner, lucide-react.
Ensure the layout relies heavily on grids (Control Room mode) with gap-4 or gap-6. Keep it dense and scannable.
The webcam component must have a clear visual frame (e.g., reticle corners or bright 1px border) to indicate active monitoring.
All Shadcn components (Button, Input, Table, Dialog, Toast) must be configured to use rounded-none and strict borders to match the brutalist aesthetic.
Use standard data-testid attributes for testing.
